title: EVENT PROMO — Cabrillo High School Aquarium, 40th anniversary open house + mural unveiling, Wed Sep 23 2026
vo_lines: Nineteen eighty-six. A school club. One classroom. A few tanks.
Today? More than twenty live and static displays.
Three galleries. Hundreds of students. Thousands of visitors.
Four point six stars. Over a hundred reviews.
And now: the Choomash Kelp Forest mural.
Made with two Noah national marine sanctuaries.
Tomorrow night. Six to eight. Free. Constellation Road.
note: Every figure is sourced in content/social/posts/2026-09-22-aquarium-40.md. The three clips are generated mood: no chip or title on a clip names the aquarium, its tanks or its mural as the thing pictured.
